title: ‘Housewives’ Star Jen Shah Finishes Federal Prison Sentence: “I Feel Blessed. I Feel Free” (Exclusive)
summary: The former 'Real Housewives of Salt Lake City' star shares a statement with THR about her release: "For a very long time, I wasn’t in a position to speak for myself while my story continued to be told around me. There is a lot people know about my story, and there is also a lot they don’t."
tags: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
